## What's new in AniTenshi 1.0.22

- **Up to date with Animetail and Mihon**: this version brings in Animetail's latest update from Mihon.
- **New options for the fast manga reader (WebGPU)**, in the reader's settings: crop instead of zoom, turn off tiles (the page is drawn in one go), show all tiles together instead of one by one, and choose the filter used to enlarge or shrink pages ("Upscaler" and "Downscaler", each with its own settings).
- **A new panel for titles in Home**: holding a title of "Continue watching" or "Continue reading" now opens a panel from the bottom instead of a plain window. It shows the cover, where you are ("Ep. 5 · 2 left") with the gold bar if you stopped halfway, a big gold button to resume, then "Open the page" and "Hide", which says where hidden titles end up. The list of hidden titles has the same look, with covers and a "Show again" button. It closes by tapping outside or dragging it down; on tablets it stays narrow and centred.
- **A new panel for sources in Browse**: holding a source (anime or manga) now opens the same kind of panel from the bottom, with its icon, name and language, the buttons "Browse" and "Latest", then "Pin to the top" or "Unpin", "Exclude from data saver" (when the data saver is on) and "Disable" in red, each with a line on what it does. In Italian, "Unpin" no longer reads "Sblocca".
- **Behind the scenes**: newer build tools (Android Gradle Plugin, Gradle, Metro, jsoup).
- The new texts are also in Italian.
